P i y u s h G o e l

+91-7678427163 • piyushgoel1996@gmail.com

PROFILE SUMMARY

7 years of experience in Networking Domain, experience in design, implementation and troubleshooting of Networking Infrastructure.

Extensive experience in delivering projects, planning for network implementation at enterprise level

Experience

Sr. Network Engineer | Ameriprise Financial | Gurgaon, Haryana(Oct 2024 – PRESENT)

Working in Ameriprise Network Team which comes under Technology department where managing their datacenters, headquarter offices and remote offices also managing their subsidiaries Columbia Threadneedle Investments datacenters and remote offices in multiple locations EMEA, APAC, USA.

Working on priority or severity issues P3, and P2 issues.  Proactively join P2 bridges when Network Team is required and perform live troubleshooting to check network connectivity issues and suggest next action or root cause

Create SOP documents to help Team in troubleshooting issues, process introduced in Team and upload it at team confluence page, create HLD and LLD of network infra for better understanding

Working and follow up with different vendors to resolve the issue quickly and share the RFO to management.

Apart from day to day work, actively participating in other Network related activities to enhance my skills.

Technology Analyst | Infosys | Bengaluru

NOV 2022 – SEPT 2024

Provide 24x7x365 support for LAN/WAN, Wireless support.  Performing configuration changes and troubleshooting on Legacy and SDWAN(Viptela) migrated sites using templates.

Administration, Operation and support including monitoring, maintenance, management of network services.

Take ownership of incidents, communications and partner engagement for complex & critical incidents

Clearly escalate incidents and problems internally and with external parties where required.  Perform configuration changes on network devices as per requirement  Upgrading switches hardware and software to avoid vulnerability.

Associate | Capgemini | Gurugram

NOV 2021 – NOV 2022

Working as a Cisco TAC cases for UCS Servers and Virtualization  Responsible for providing complete Hardware, Software, Planning and troubleshooting support to Cisco’s customer registered with Cisco service contract.

 To analyze problems of Data center products like UCSM, FI, IOM, UCS-B, UCS-C.  Troubleshooting on Fabric Interconnect in Linux shell mode.  Troubleshooting and workaround day to day related issues as per customer requirement.

Analyst | HCL Technologies | Noida

AUG 2018 – FEB 2019 – INTERN MARCH 2019 – NOV 2021 – FULL TIME

Monitoring the customer network with the help of Netcure monitoring tool.  Being Tier1 engineer, providing remote technical support to the client in troubleshooting.  Performing basic troubleshooting of Data Centre to Data Centre connectivity and escalate to required group for advance troubleshooting.

Escalating with Tier2 and Tier3 for any high critical is impacting large number of users

Technical Skills

Routing Switching: VLAN, STP,HSRP,VTP, Ether-Channel, Stacking, EIGRP, OSPF, BGP.  Nexus: Knowledge of Nexus 7k,5k, 2k  Knowledge of VDC,VPC, FEX  Servers and Virtualization: IOM, UCS-B, UCS-C, UCS-S, and UCS-E series , FI

Understanding of Other Tech.

F5 LTM : Configuring Virtual Server, Upgrade, Monitor, Proxy, Load Balancing, SNAT and Automap, Persistence

Palo Alto: Understanding of Palo Alto. URL Filtering, Content Based Filtering, Application Based Filtering, and traffic monitoring

Basic Knowledge of Cisco Wireless and Linux

Certification

CCNA 200-301  CCNP 300-415 

Achievements

Received Appreciations from customers, Managers and Senior managers in all companies.  Performer of the month for 7 month continuously in HCL Technologies 

Education 2014-2018 Computer Science Engineering – 2018 GGSIPU, Delhi

Hobbies Travelling, Gaming, and Reading.
